title: My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute To Live With! Releases Teaser PV and Cast News
content:
The Deregula YouTube Channel has revealed a promo video for My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! The PV featured information on some of the anime’s cast and staff. Doukyo Shiteiru Kensei o Onna Shinshou ga Kawisugite Mainichi Shiawase Desu will premiere in January. Studio Wolfsbane and Lightbox are animating the adaptation.

The anime’s voice cast includes

• Ai Kakuma as Liza Parsandra

• Seena Hoshiki as Eugene Dawson

• Azusa Tsujimori as Erin Toa

• Hitomi Ueda as Cordelia Dawson

• Miyu Tomita as Fiona Rosso

• Minami Takahashi as Lumiere Theomere

• Tomoyo Takayanagi as Meris Eclipse

• Hitomi Ueda as the Narrator

Masayoshi Nishida, known for his directorial work on Makina-san’s a Love Bot! will direct My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! Additional staff includes

• Noriyoshi Sasaki — Technical Director

• Ichirou Tanaka — Character Design

• Ayame Eto —Sub Character Design

• Youhei Kashii — Scripts

• Yusho Hayakawa — Chief Animation Director & Sub Character Design

• 12Sound — Music

You can view the PV below.

My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! tells the story of Eugene Dawson, who, in his quest to become stronger, becomes an apprentice to the Sword Saint Liza. Although Liza’s skills are feared on the battlefield, she’s a total klutz in everyday life. Can Eugene train properly when Liza’s clumsiness and accidental perviness keep distracting him?

Kennoji and illustrator R_ringo launched My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! in March 2024. Kadokawa’s KadoComi has serialized the manga since its debut. The publisher has since compiled the manga into two volumes. Seven Seas Entertainment releases the series in English through its Ghost Ship imprint.

title: This Solo Leveling Competitor Ended With No Season 2 Hopes, But It Really Needs More Episodes
content:
The Fall 2026 anime season has finally begun after concluding the Summer series. While the ongoing season is airing the sequels of The Apothecary Diaries and Black Clover, the previous season was famous for unique debuts. Tomb Raider King is one of the most hyped shows on Crunchyroll, which concluded its first season before the Fall 2026 season began. While the anticipated Solo Leveling movie is still a while away , fans were able to fill the void this Summer 2026 season with the debut of Tomb Raider King . The anime grabbed attention for sharing striking similarities with the popular manhwa adaptation even before its premiere.

Solo Leveling isn’t the first manhwa adaptation, but there’s no denying that the anime industry has seen a boom in these stories ever since its popularity. Tomb Raider King is another one of those series that shared similar vibes to this massive hit . It was initially expected to conclude on September 24th, but it was hit with an unexpected delay due to broadcasting issues. However, while the series has already reached its finale, there haven’t been any updates on the second season yet. The anime is based on a popular webtoon of the same name, which has over 400 chapters. This means that the anime has only covered the initial phase of the story.

Tomb Raider King Deserves Another Chance With Season 2

After the initial hype died down, the anime didn’t manage to sustain its popularity. Instead of being considered a massive hit, the series is a sleeper underperformer with mixed reviews. However, since the story is much longer than Solo Leveling , it’s taking its time setting up the premise and introducing fans to the world-building. The story follows Jooheon as he embarks on a journey after traveling back in time so he can take revenge on those who betrayed him. Tomb Raider King primarily leans into a corporate treasure war, comedy, and stealing powerful artifacts from rivals using prior knowledge of the future. While the anime has barely scratched the surface of the story , things will get more intense for Jooheon in his path of revenge.

The season finale ended on a massive cliffhanger as Ryoga reveals himself as the main villain of the story who plans to collect all relics and dominate the world. The anime should have been renewed for a second season right after the finale broadcast, which is common for major shows. However, it’s also not unusual for anime shows to drop sequel confirmations after making fans wait for a few months or even more than a year. As of now, it can’t be certain if the anime will ever return with a sequel, especially after the poor reviews it received during the time of its broadcast. Even so, we can’t rule out the possibility that the studio might need some time before the official confirmation, considering the scale of the project.

Head down to the comments below to let us know if you are anticipating a second season of Tomb Raider King. Or you could tell us your favorite moment from the webtoon that you want to see in the anime.

title: How Not to Summon a Demon Lord Ult Releases Visual & Staff Details
content:
The production committee for How Not to Summon a Demon Lord ULT has released a teaser visual and details about the main staff. Tezuka Productions will return to animate the series. Studio Okuruto Noboru, which worked on the previous season, will not be involved.

Satoshi Kuwabara is also returning as director. His other directing credits include The Quintessential Quintuplets and The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses . Other returning staff members include series composer Kazuyuki Fudeyasu and character designer Shizue Kaneko.

Additional staff members for Isekai Maou to Shoukan Shoujo no Dorei Majutsu Ult include:

• Zenjiro Ukelele (previously season 2’s chief animation director) — Character Design

• Satoshi Motoyama — Sound Director

• Yuusuke Katou — Music

How Not to Summon a Demon Lord ULT ’s main VAs will reprise their roles.

• Masaaki Mizunaka as Diablo

• Azumi Waki as Rem

• Yu Serizawa as Shera

The production committee has not yet announced a premiere date for Season 3. Crunchyroll streams the first two seasons.

The series is based on How Not to Summon a Demon Lord, a light novel written by Yukiya Murasaki and illustrated by Takahiro Tsurusaki. Its story follows Takuma Sakamoto, a hikikomori NEET who spends his days playing the MMORPG Cross Reverie . Though he’s a top-ranked player, his life outside the game is less impressive.

One day, Takuma finds himself in a world that mimics Cross Reverie ! And to add to his confusion, he’s in the body of his Cross Reverie character, the Demon Lord Diablo! But what is he doing there? Well, a demi-human and an elf summoned Diable to make him their servant!

Unfortunately for them, Diablo’s magical ring reverses the spell, making them his servants instead. Now stuck in Cross Reverie , Diablo must survive his newfound world with his servants in tow.

title: 5 Fall 2026 Anime That Nailed Their Premiere
content:
It is already the last season of 2026, but the anime industry is still not done for the year, as the Fall season is filled with dozens of great anime that have already aired, with many more yet to come. In the first week, fans got to see the return of many great anime with new seasons, proving that this season is an epic one for series returning with their new seasons.

However, there are many new anime debuting as well, including an anime adaptation of a cancelled Shonen Jump manga. While there are already dozens of anime airing weekly and more yet to come, it can be a bit much to decide what anime to watch. Therefore, one factor that could help fans narrow down the list is the quality of their premiere episodes, and there are five in particular that totally nailed their premieres.

5) Psyren

One of the new anime that no one could have expected to come out this season is actually Psyren , which stems from the manga that was serialized in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump almost 20 years ago before being cancelled . However, this year has proven that cancelled manga can still get anime adaptations, and Psyren ‘s premiere nailed it. Since the series stems from the shonen genre, its premiere does well to capture the essence of shonen.

However, what makes it stand out is how the anime preserves the era of late-2000s anime, with the studio giving it the perfect animation style. But it is actually the narrative, featuring the main character receiving a red phone card from a telephone of all things, that makes it capture the vibe. As the episode comes to an end, it presents a survival game narrative with its main character, embodying the perfect rowdy shonen protagonist and positioning this anime to emerge as the best shonen anime of Fall 2026.

4) The Apothecary Diaries Season 3

One of the most anticipated Fall 2026 titles is undoubtedly The Apothecary Diaries Season 3, and its premiere proves why this anime continues to be a historical drama series that everyone loves. The premiere immediately dives into what makes this anime so great, featuring multilayered drama with Maomao and Jinshi both positioned in the appropriate places, while slowly setting up the pieces for what is to come throughout the rest of the season.

While some fans might be feeling off about the premiere’s slow pacing, it is actually this masterpiece element that draws viewers in. It is done through Maomao, as she depicts what is happening with the locust situation, allowing viewers to feel like they are participating in the unfolding mystery rather than simply having everything laid out and explained to them. With the premiere setting up the beloved characters’ reunion and the villain as well, The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 couldn’t have started on a better note.

3) Black Clover Season 2

Black Clover ‘s return as one of the biggest shonen anime has been awaited since the anime went on hiatus in March 2021, as fans have been desperately wanting to see the next steps in Asta’s story. With the manga even shifting magazines, fans were really worried about the anime’s future; however, after many prayers and wishes, the anime is finally back with its second season, and it looks crisp and amazing. The premiere immediately picks up where it left off.

Without wasting any time, it sees Asta’s new power upgrade being set in motion against the enemies coming in this new arc, while the villains themselves make an impact as the fight also begins to play out in the first episode. With this pacing, the anime has made it clear that it will abandon the slow pacing of the previous season, as it adapts around four chapters and more, aiming to adapt the rest of the material as soon as possible. While this is a better approach, as the anime has been accused of slow pacing, it is disappointing that even Black Clover is abandoning the long format , hinting that the long-running Shonen Jump era has come to an end entirely.

2) Overgeared

It seems to have become the norm for every new season of the year to feature an anime that is compared to Solo Leveling , especially those adapted from Korean webcomics, or Webtoons. This Fall has Overgeared , which, from its premise, makes it clear that it has elements of Solo Leveling ; however, it has its own nuances on top of those elements, making it an engaging anime.

Overgeared does this through its protagonist and gaming system. With the protagonist’s in-game name being Grid and the game, Satisfy, providing real-life status and money, Grid’s journey is about gaining status through the game, as he is a loser in real life. What makes Grid’s journey different is that he isn’t afraid to show his weak side, which is presented in a comical way, making the anime feel humorous while also providing a self-improvement journey. This makes it worlds apart from Solo Levelin g and gives it a refreshing feel.

1) Blue Box Season 2

While almost all the other series on this list are about action elements in some way, Blue Box Season 2 is the anime airing this season that feels the most refreshing, as it has the perfect blend of sports and romance that makes it so different. However, the premiere of the second season goes even further by depicting Chinatsu and Taiki’s first date, which fans have been wanting to see for a long time, creating the perfect romantic tension.

Yet the series continues to present its sports element, and this time, it does so boldly, reminding fans, and even the main characters, that sports are an important part of their lives and balancing the two will prove to be very difficult for them. The anime presents this through two scenarios involving both of them. This makes Blue Box ‘s premiere stand out much more than the others and gears it up for the next episodes, which will make this anime arguably stand out even more in the Fall 2026 season.

title: Unique 2027 Isekai Anime Aims To Take The Genre In A New Direction – Watch
content:
Isekai is a powerhouse genre within the anime industry that continues to grow every year despite fans oftentimes echoing that the reuse of tropes and low-effort story lines of each new series getting pushed out season to season has caused something of a fatigue toward to concept among audiences. While there have been some compelling sub-genres that have appeared to counteract this exhaustion, such as the Villainess Reincarnation trope that has put more of a focus on female audiences, even those stories have found themselves rehashing similar plot beats and character tropes. However, there’s hope on the horizon for isekai, as STUDIO CLUTCH and Animation Studio Seven just announced an animated adaptation of The Otome Heroine’s Fight for Survival .

The Otome Heroine’s Fight for Survival is an extremely unique take on isekai, as its main character, Alicia, isn’t someone from the real-world being reborn into the body of a game character. Instead, she’s the heroine of a dating simulation video game who becomes self aware after she recovers memories from a past life. Instead of settling into the role of a love-seeking damsel, Alicia runs from the game’s main plot to instead train for survival and embarks on a blood-soaked journey into the game’s surprisingly violent fantasy world to become a powerful warrior.

The Otome Heroine’s Fight for Survival Promises To Change Isekai As Fans Know It

Originally a web novel series written by Harunohi Biyori, The Otome Heroine’s Fight for Survival ran for three years between 2019 and 2022 before being picked up by TO Books to be adapted into a series of printed, officially published light novels with illustrations by Yuu Hitaki. Interestingly, while many other series within the genre will oftentimes still have the lead character interact with, befriend, and even unwittingly fall in love with the romance options in whatever game’s story they’re trying to evade, Alicia dodges her potential suitors entirely. She is a protagonist with seemingly zero interest in the prospects of romance, and in the brief moments throughout the novels that she does come into contact with the male leads from the game’s story, she only views their interactions with pragmatism.

This avoidance does get touched on later in the series, with a major story arc surrounding a “fake Alicia” — another young woman who becomes self-aware about the nature of the dating simulator they reside within used her recovered knowledge to sway the suitors for her own gain. This major plot point is explored even further as Alicia and Princess Elena, the villainess of the dating sim, begin to develop feelings for one another that go well beyond friendship. The Otome Heroine’s Fight for Survival uses common genre tropes to its advantage, reinventing and playing with them in a clever way that completely subverts what fans of the medium might be looking for when they jump into the series for the first time .

When Can Anime Fans Watch The Otome Heroine’s Fight for Survival?

The Otome Heroine’s Fight for Survival is slated to release sometime in July 2027 as part of the Summer 2027 anime season . Produced in a joint effort from STUDIO CLUTCH and Animation Studio Seven, Noriyoshi Sasaki will be directing the series. Previously known for his work on series like The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You , Blue Lock and JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Diamond Is Unbreakable , he will be joined by Toko Machida from YAIBA: Samurai Legend working on series composition, character designs from Hiroyuki Miseki, as well as KOHTA YAMAMOTO, Shun Narita and Yuki Furuhashi, all of whom will be composing the show’s original soundtrack.

For those wanting to get caught up before the anime airs, Harunohi Biyori and Yu Hitaki’s original light novel series is available in English from J-Novel Club , whose currently published the series’s collected volumes up to Volume 6, with Volume 7 slated to release in early January 2027. The manga adaptation of the series is available in English as well, with eight volumes currently available for purchase. As of writing, there is no scheduled release date for subsequent volumes of the series in either medium, nor has there been any confirmation as to where the anime will begin streaming for worldwide audiences once it releases in July 2027.

title: Yen Press Licenses Fate/strange Fake, Kino's Journey, Spice and Wolf Diner: Gourmet Exploration, More Manga/Novels
content:
Yen Press announced the following licenses at New York Comic Con on Friday:

A horse-drawn carriage races across the cosmos. Or rather, a spaceship made to look like one. At the helm are a pair of refugees who fled Earth after pollution rendered it uninhabitable: Ridley, a scientist and the designer of this peculiar spacecraft, and Watari, an accomplished martial artist with debilitating shyness. This eccentric duo has but one goal—to find a stable planet where they can settle down on!

However, every world the two visit is a little off… A planet with a god that can revive the dead, a planet where lucky people reign supreme, a planet lined with endless libraries… Can the girls navigate the unique challenges posed by each bizarre world and live to reach the next leg of their journey? And is there really a replacement for Earth waiting to be found among the stars?

So there I am on my death bed when a literal devil comes to make a deal with me. I get a second shot at life, and in exchange, I'm on the hook for designing the most enticing dungeon her world has ever seen. Pretty sweet deal, if you ask me. Let's see, how do we get people to explore the dungeon? How about if we offer hot springs capable of rejuvenating skin, reversing the effects of aging, and granting you crazy strength? Whoops… Looks like our baths are too popular and are causing some geopolitical strife. Well, it's just another day in the life of a dungeon master!

It has been several years since the conclusion of the Fifth Holy Grail War. Now the stage has been set for a brand-new battle in Snowfield, a city in the western United States. But this iteration of the war is built on lies. Mages and Heroic Spirits gather upon a false stage. And though they grow increasingly aware that something is amiss, they play their roles all the same. Truth and fiction no longer matter, for these competitors fight not for the Grail, but to see their personal convictions through to the end. But when the final drop of blood is shed and the battle draws to a close, what secrets will this enigmatic conflict uncover…?

So begins the story of a boy in search of a friend and a clumsy poltergeist in need of a little human kindness… The best of friendships come from the most unexpected places!

title: October’s Biggest Dark Romance Anime Drops Gorgeous New Trailer – Watch
content:
The Fall 2026 Anime season is absolutely stacked with highly-anticipated new releases, with the return of popular series like The Apothecary Diaries , Black Clover Season 2 , Blue Box Season 2 , and the return of Tokyo Revengers . There’s plenty of new series dropping as well, with romance fans hyping up the release of Firefly Wedding from David Production, the official anime adaptation of the original web manga from Oreco Tachibana. This dark, historical romance manga blew up upon its release in 2023 thanks to its doomed love story, with its leads: Satoko Kirigaya, a beautiful young woman and daughter of an earl whose life is on a time limit due to an incurable heart condition, and Shinpei Goto, a mysterious assassin initially hired to kill her before Satoko barters for her life by proposing the two get married.

With the original manga coming to an end earlier in 2026, fans of the series have been anxiously awaiting the release of the anime adaptation, and David Productions has put in the work to bring Firefly Wedding and its eccentric leading couple to life. Directed by Takahiro Kamei, the same creative mind behind 2022’s modern reboot of Rumiko Takahashi’s Urusei Yatsura , David Production’s has dropped a special character trailer of the show’s murderous heartthrob Shinpei to showcase some of his best moments in the show’s upcoming premiere.

Firefly Wedding’s New Trailer Perfectly Captures The Manga’s Heartbreaking Love Story

Shinpei’s character trailer hyping up the Firefly Wedding premiere is nothing short of perfect, showing off the character’s adorable facial expressions and tenderness toward his bride-to-be, Satoko, contrasted beautifully with his more murderous qualities interspersed throughout. Shinpei is played by Kouki Uchiyama, whose voice is slowly beginning to dominate the anime industry, taking on the role of other prominent characters like Kei Tsukishima in Haikyu!! , Shigaraki in My Hero Academia , and Toge Inumaki in Jujutsu Kaisen , as well as leading roles in other new anime slated to release throughout the remainder of 2026 into 2027, such as D in Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 .

His voice is a perfect fit for Shinpei, a sadistic trained assassin who is capable of efficiently taking down hoards of lesser-prepared foes while reserving a peculiar softness for Satoko Kirigaya. Satoko will be played by Lynn, previously known for her roles in Mushoku Tensei as Lilia Greyart, Fire Force as Hibana, and Uma Musume as Maruzensky. With the series releasing in October 2026 as part of the Fall Anime season, there hasn’t been any hard confirmation on how far into the manga the first season of the anime plans to explore, however, those looking to watch the adaptation will be able to stream Firefly Wedding worldwide on Crunchyroll .

There’s No Other Doomed Romance Quite Like Firefly Wedding

Firefly Wedding takes place during the Meiji era and predominantly follows a stunningly beautiful young woman named Satoko Kirigaya, the daughter of an earl whose critical heart condition has sentenced her to a shortened life due to the medical care she has access to. Satoko wishes to marry into a good family in spite of her circumstances, but ends up getting kidnapped by a band of assassins. In a desperate attempt to escape, she strikes a deal with one of them: a younger man named Shinpei, to marry her and to save her from being killed. He agrees, and while Satoko initially only clings to the posessive, murderous Shinpei for a chance at survival, she ends up falling in love with him. Originally published online by Oreco Tachibana in 2023 through Shogakukan’s MangaONE before moving to Ura Sunday .

The manga exploded in popularity over its three year run, having over 5 million copies in circulation following the release of its final chapter. In 2024, Firefly Wedding won the grand prize at NTT Solmare’s Digital Comic Awards, and ranked first in the Nationwide Bookstore Employees’ Recommended Comics list that same year. This massively popular shojo series has cemented itself as a modern success for the demographic, and has quickly eclipsed Oreco Tachibana’s debut work, Promise Cinderella in popularity despite being a short series. With the release of the anime adaptation , Firefly Wedding ‘s popularity will only grow as more fans are introduced to this infamous couple.

title: 7 Years Later, Attack on Titan Director Opens Up About MAPPA’s Takeover
content:
WIT Studio was established in 2012, and the very first anime produced by the studio was Attack on Titan . Based on the award-winning manga written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama, the anime debuted in 2013 and didn’t take long before capturing viewers’ attention. While WIT is one of the most renowned animation studios in Japan right now, it faced major struggles during the production of Attack on Titan . For a new studio without any foothold in the industry, it was an incredibly ambitious project. However, there’s no denying that WIT Studio was probably the best choice for the series. The first three seasons are still praised for laying the groundwork for the story.

Whether it’s the visuals or the fluid movements, hardly any anime even now can compare to it. The anime had an exceptional run for the first three seasons, but things changed drastically after the time skip. WIT Studio wrapped up the second part of Season 3 in 2019, a couple of years before the manga reached its conclusion. The story took a drastic turn in the post-timeskip era, sparking several controversies and fan debates even after the manga’s finale in 2021. It’s been more than seven years since WIT Studio wrapped up Season 3, and the Chief Animation Director finally opens up about the unexpected change.

Attack on Titan Shares Thoughts on MAPPA’s Adaptation in Final Season

In an interview with Anime News Network , the Chief Animation Director, Tetsuro Araki, shared, “For various reasons, MAPPA took over the series. They continued it with a level of quality that didn’t fall short of ours. If anything, I think they achieved an even higher level of quality. When you look at the story as a whole, everything fits together. You can watch all of the episodes straight through.” He continued, “In the end, MAPPA brought the series to its conclusion, and that cultural legacy was completed. I think that’s an incredibly rare thing. I think Attack on Titan is a miraculous work, and I don’t think something like it will come along again very easily.”

While the first three seasons of the anime are still loved, WIT Studio had to wash its hands of the series for various reasons. Things changed completely around the time the manga was in its final stretch, which means the studio was under a tight deadline to wrap up the story as soon as possible. Although Araki didn’t open up about the reason behind the change in studio, he praised MAPPA’s adaptation. WIT Studio originally wanted the anime to become a cultural legacy, and while they did their part, it wouldn’t have been possible if MAPPA’s adaptation wasn’t equally as amazing . While WIT Studio initially faced difficulties over its next flagship title, things turned out for the better when Spy x Family was introduced. Spy x Family is another acclaimed Shonen Jump series, and the anime is a collaborative project between WIT Studio and CloverWorks.

MAPPA Is Planning a Major Return for Attack on Titan Fans

At this point, the anime can’t continue since the manga never returned with a new chapter or any sequel after wrapping things up. Isayama dealt with severe stress and even health issues when the manga was in its final stretch. Things only got worse due to the extreme criticism from fans, which might be another reason why he never returned with an extra or even a new story, even now. However, both animation studios often revive the anime in theatres with new versions of the already released episodes or compilations, but that’s all we can expect from the anime right now.

September 9th has been declared as the official Attack on Titan Day, which means the franchise will reveal new updates every year while commemorating this special day. Not only that, MAPPA will adapt the final storyline for the upcoming game, Attack on Titan 3 . The game will be released on December 10th, 2026, which gives fans something new to look forward to by the end of the year. Additionally, the series is also listed among the MAPPA projects that will be displayed during the 15th anniversary Expo.

title: Ize Press Announces Print Editions of Regas, Eat Before You Go Webtoons
content:
Ize Press announced two new Korean webtoon titles, Regas and Eat Before You Go , at the Yen Press Industry Panel at New York Comic-Con on Friday.

Regas , illustrated by Daengmeong and adapted by Lee kkeut from the original story by samk, is an ongoing fantasy BL webtoon set in a kingdom where the royal bloodline inherits the blessings of a dragon.

The story follows a powerful crown prince whose supernatural abilities have come at the cost of his sanity. Abel, a Regas trained to tame coldhearted monarchs, is tasked with caring for the prince and gradually tries to teach him about the world around him amid growing political turmoil.

The webtoon has more than two million views across Lezhin , Tappytoon , Manta , and Tapas .

Ize Press also announced Eat Before You Go , illustrated by "the Bichon" and adapted by Kim Haema from the original story by Ko Doo Yeol.

The fantasy webtoon follows Miro Laikas, a hero who returns to Earth after spending 30 years defeating a demon lord, only to discover that his home is now overrun with monsters. Rather than continuing his life as a hero, Miro opens a restaurant and uses monster parts as ingredients for his cooking.

Published digitally on WEBTOON , Eat Before You Go has more than eight million views. The series combines fantasy, cooking, and slice-of-life elements, with Miro running his restaurant, raising a baby dragon, and occasionally fighting powerful enemies.

Ize Press has not yet announced release dates or preorder information for either title.

title: Firefly Wedding Manga Gets Live-Action Adaptation on TV in 2027
content:
The official website for the television anime of Oreko Tachibana 's Firefly Wedding ( Hotaru no Yomeiri ) manga announced on Saturday that the manga is getting a live-action adaptation on Fuji TV in 2027. The website streamed a video, but it is not available in the U.S.

Viz Media publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story:

On the surface, Satoko has it all—she's beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family's eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

Tachibana launched the manga on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app in January 2023, and ended it on January 12. Shogakukan published the 12th compiled book volume on June 19, and will release the 13th and final volume on October 19. A volume of spinoff chapters will launch on the same day.
